Action Taken

  1. Block-wise beneficiary list was compiled from the AWS/BIS data and circulated to the concerned DNOs (District Nodal Officers) and DIMs for targeted follow-up during the card generation drive.
  2. A work order was issued to CSC to support the DIU unit in the field. All Deputy Commissioners (DCs) were requested to extend support to the card saturation drives in their respective districts.
  3. As the overall saturation level was found unsatisfactory, the special camp period (originally up to 14-Sep-2026) has been extended up to 14-Nov-2026 to allow additional time for saturation.
  4. Blocks with coverage below 65% were identified from the block-wise beneficiary coverage report, and a special request was sent to the respective district DNOs/DIMs to expedite saturation in these blocks on priority.
  5. District-wise, scheme-wise and period-wise AWS reports have been shared with the field units to assist them in targeted follow-up and closing of pending cases.

"Net Total Active Cards" (1,41,67,285) = Scheme-wise Total (1,41,20,574) + only the currently active CHIRAYU Extension window (PX3: 46,711, per the latest district-wise Extension pull — see Extra Reports tab). Expired PX and PX2 windows are excluded from the active count.

Data Flow Workflow — e-Pensioner Portal to NHA

All CCHF pensioner data requests and transfers between Bank, Treasury and NHA are routed through the e-Pensioner Portal:

1. Request raised

When data needs to be sent from Bank to Treasury (or vice versa), a request is placed on the e-Pensioner Portal using the predefined Excel format.

↓
2. Treasury receives request

Treasury logs into its own e-Pensioner Portal login and receives the request/data submitted in Step 1.

↓
3. Data stored in database

Once received, the data is saved into the underlying database maintained on the e-Pensioner Portal.

↓
4. NIC API

NIC has built an API on top of this database, which exposes the pensioner data for consumption by NHA.

↓
5. NHA fetches data

NHA hits/calls the NIC API to pull the pensioner data into the BIS/AWS system.
